Hello, OpenSandbox

EXERCISE 09 / 12 · exercices/09_opensandbox_backend.py
Write the sandbox backend
Put the exercise 8 SDK calls behind deepagents' BaseSandbox interface.
1
create(): start a sandbox through OPENSANDBOX_SERVER_CONFIG, wrap it
return cls(await Sandbox.create(image, connection_config=...))
2
id: expose the sandbox id
return self.sandbox.id
3
aexecute: run it with self.sandbox.commands.run; exit_code is None on success
ExecuteResponse(output=str(ex), exit_code=ex.exit_code or 0)
4
aupload_files: write every (path, data) pair
await self.sandbox.files.write_files([WriteEntry(...), ...])
5
adownload_files: read every path
FileDownloadResponse(path=p, content=await ...read_bytes(p))

YOUR TURN · skills/ + exercices/11_deep_agent_skills.py
Write your own skill
Package some know-how as a skill, and make the agent find it and run it.

Create a folder next to csv-report and release-notes
